chapter_name: Chapter 01: The Sentence and its Parts
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will understand what a sentence is, learn the four kinds of sentences, and identify the subject and predicate in a sentence.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Welcome to Class 5! 🎉 Have you ever tried talking using only random words? It doesn't make much sense! Let's learn how to group words perfectly into sentences and discover the two main parts every sentence needs to be complete.

lesson_modules.module_title: 📝 What is a Sentence? (वाक्य क्या है?)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A sentence is a group of words that makes complete sense. It always begins with a Capital Letter and ends with a full stop (.), question mark (?), or exclamation mark (!).
examples_or_templates: The sun rises in the east.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Every complete sentence has two parts. The 'Subject' is who or what the sentence is about. The 'Predicate' is the part that tells us something about the subject.
examples_or_templates: My best friend (Subject) loves playing chess (Predicate).

lesson_modules.teaching_content: There are four main types of sentences: Declarative (gives information/statement), Interrogative (asks a question), Imperative (gives a command or request), and Exclamatory (shows sudden, strong emotion).
examples_or_templates: Interrogative: Have you finished your homework?

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which part of the sentence names the person or thing we are talking about?
❓ What kind of sentence is 'Please close the door.'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Identify the Subject in this sentence: 'The clever fox jumped over the wall.'
subjective_practice.hint: Ask yourself: 'Who' jumped over the wall?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Make a meaningful sentence using these jumbled words: (playing / park / are / children / in / the).
subjective_practice.hint: Start with a capital letter: 'The children...'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write an Interrogative sentence about your favorite hobby.
subjective_practice.hint: It should ask a question and end with a '?'.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🕵️ Sentence Detective
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Pick any short paragraph from your English literature textbook. Find one Declarative sentence and one Interrogative sentence. Write them down and underline the Subject in both!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A sentence is a group of words making complete sense.
⭐ The Subject is what the sentence is about, and the Predicate tells us about the subject.
⭐ The 4 types of sentences are: Declarative, Interrogative, Imperative, and Exclamatory.
